normative_extracts.quote: A modal dialog is rendered in the top layer and makes all other elements in the document inert.

browser_support.notes: React createPortal + manual z-index layering is superseded by native <dialog>.showModal() and [popover] Top Layer primitives.

pipeline_phases: Manual Scroll Lock & Focus Trap JS
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: createPortal teleports DOM nodes to document.body to escape local overflow clipping, yet still fights global z-index tokens and requires manual focus trapping.

production_failures.symptom: Toast notification renders behind a modal opened by a third-party widget
production_failures.root_cause: Both components use createPortal into document.body with competing hardcoded z-index values (z-50 vs z-[9999]).
production_failures.mitigation: Migrate overlays to native <dialog>.showModal() and [popover] so the Browser Top Layer manages stacking order.

production_failures.symptom: Screen reader and Tab key escape an open portal modal into background page links
production_failures.root_cause: createPortal moves the DOM node to document.body without marking sibling subtrees inert or trapping focus.
production_failures.mitigation: Use <dialog>.showModal() which automatically applies modal inertness and focus restoration.
